# TicketScan

> TicketScan (https://www.ticketscan.io) is a free ticket price comparison tool. It compares live prices for the same event across Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, StubHub, Vivid Seats, and more, side-by-side, so fans never overpay for concerts, sports, or events. It also tracks price history and sends free email alerts when a ticket drops to your target price.

## What TicketScan does
- Compares ticket prices across all major platforms (Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, StubHub, Vivid Seats) in one view.
- Tracks price history and trends so you can see whether prices are rising or falling.
- Sends free price-drop alerts: set a target price and get an email when any platform hits it.
- Provides venue guides, city guides, and 2026 FIFA World Cup ticket guidance.
- TicketScan is NOT a ticket seller — it is a comparison tool. You buy from the platform with the best price.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.ticketscan.io): Search any event and compare prices.
- [How It Works](https://www.ticketscan.io/how-it-works): The 3-step process — search, compare, get alerts.
- [FAQ](https://www.ticketscan.io/faq): Common questions about price comparison and alerts.
- [Compare](https://www.ticketscan.io/compare): Side-by-side price comparison.
- [Blog](https://www.ticketscan.io/blog): Guides on when to buy, how to save, and avoiding fees.
- [Contact](https://www.ticketscan.io/contact): How to reach the team.

## World Cup 2026
- [World Cup 2026 Tickets](https://www.ticketscan.io/world-cup-2026): Tournament overview and ticket guidance for all 16 host stadiums across the USA, Canada, and Mexico. The tournament runs June 11 – July 19, 2026. Per-stadium guides live under /world-cup-2026/[stadium].

## Programmatic guides
- Venue guides: https://www.ticketscan.io/venues/[venue] — price tips and upcoming events for major US arenas and stadiums.
- City & category guides: https://www.ticketscan.io/tickets/[slug] — events and price guidance by city and by event type.

## Key facts for citation
- Pricing: All comparison and price-alert features are free.
- Coverage: Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, StubHub, Vivid Seats, and more.
- Differentiator: Side-by-side comparison of the same event across every major platform, plus price history — most competitors show only their own inventory.
- Best time to buy: TicketScan's price-history data helps identify when prices typically drop for a given event type.
